title: HuBMAP TMC-Florida/Zurich CODEX Modality Overview
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be9pjh5n
materials: Validate antibodies in all target tissue types by IHC using DAB Staining: https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdiei4be
Stain coverslips with Akoya invertoried antibodies. Staining: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbsdina6
Make CODEX bar coded reporter trays. Preparation: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc2riyd6

steps.title: Register donor and organ info
steps.instruction: Register the organ donor, received organs, and common coordinate region information in the HuBMAP UUID generator at https://uuid.hubmapconsortium.org.

steps.title: Prepare paraffin blocks
steps.instruction: Process tissue samples into paraffin blocks: perform cassette processing followed by paraffin embedding.

steps.title: Prepare H&E sections
steps.instruction: Section tissue and stain with H&E for histopathological assessment.

steps.title: Coat coverslips with Poly-L-Lysine
steps.instruction: Coat coverslips with Poly‑L‑Lysine following the protocol at dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baxyifpw.

steps.title: Cut and mount CODEX sections
steps.instruction: Section and mount sections for CODEX analysis according to dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.basdiea6.

steps.title: Acquire multiplex data with CODEX robot
steps.instruction: Acquire multiplex data using the CODEX robot and a Keyence microscope as described at dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdifi4bn.

steps.title: Transfer images and process CODEX data
steps.instruction: Transfer images to the analysis computer and run CODEX processing using the Codex_Processor.docx workflow.

steps.title: Register CODEX section information
steps.instruction: Register the completed CODEX section information in the HuBMAP UUID generator at https://uuid.hubmapconsortium.org.

steps.title: Upload data to HuBMAP HIVE Globus
steps.instruction: Prepare and upload the dataset to the HuBMAP HIVE Globus via Hipergator, following the Datasets to HiperGator-Globus.docx guide.
